undo_payload.name: undo_payload
undo_payload.value: "commandUndoRecords"."payloadVersion" = 1 AND json_valid("commandUndoRecords"."payloadJson") AND length(CAST("commandUndoRecords"."payloadJson" AS BLOB)) <= 65536 AND json_array_length("commandUndoRecords"."payloadJson", '$.targets') BETWEEN 1 AND 128

files_r2.name: files_r2
files_r2.value: "files"."storageMode" != 'r2' OR ("files"."objectKey" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."contentSha256" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."mimeType" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."sizeBytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 10485760)

projects_dates.name: projects_dates
projects_dates.value: "projects"."startDate" IS NULL OR "projects"."dueDate" IS NULL OR "projects"."startDate" <= "projects"."dueDate"

tasks_dates.name: tasks_dates
tasks_dates.value: "tasks"."startDate" IS NULL OR "tasks"."dueDate" IS NULL OR "tasks"."startDate" <= "tasks"."dueDate"

tasks_cancelled.name: tasks_cancelled
tasks_cancelled.value: "tasks"."cancelledByUndoId" IS NULL OR ("tasks"."deletedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."deletedBy" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."recurrenceSourceTaskId" IS NULL)
